description: This script is a test file for Git rebase operations involving submodules. It defines functions to perform rebase actions, runs various tests to verify correct behavior during rebasing, including interactive and non-interactive rebase scenarios, and checks handling of modified submodules.

methods.name: git_rebase
methods.description: Performs a git rebase with additional status and directory listing checks, commits, reverts, and comparison of expected vs actual repository state.

methods.name: git_rebase_interactive
methods.description: Performs an interactive git rebase, including setup of a fake editor and handling of submodule states.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: Runs tests on submodule switch functionality, passing different rebase functions as parameters.
